Planned exposure, verified delivery, local control and toxicity need their own measurements.

proofPassages.supportingExcerpt: A 2010 prospective study concerned medically inoperable peripheral early-stage lung cancer and measured local control, distant failure and toxicity. That setting does not validate treatment of every central lesion or organ. CURB and NRG-BR002 tested different metastatic settings and comparisons. Local control, added progression-free or overall survival, symptom relief and an immune response are separate outcomes.

proofPassages.supportingExcerpt: Stereotactic body radiotherapy, also called SABR, uses specialised localisation, planning, positioning, image guidance and delivery to give a high dose per fraction to a body target outside the brain. A small number of visits does not establish that this delivery package was used. A biologically effective dose calculation compares modelled effects under assumptions; it does not document stereotactic localisation, motion management or verification. Modern non-stereotactic radiotherapy can also use imaging, conformal beams and motion assessment.

proofPassages.supportingExcerpt: Hypofractionation uses larger doses per fraction relative to a stated conventional comparison, commonly with fewer treatments. Keep total gray, dose per fraction, count, spacing, overall duration and treatment volume together. For equal fractions, total physical dose is the fraction count multiplied by dose per fraction; this arithmetic does not establish biological equivalence. Acceleration changes overall timing; a boost changes the dose to a selected region. Hypofractionation does not by itself identify stereotactic delivery.

proofPassages.supportingExcerpt: FAST-Forward randomised 4,096 people after surgery for early breast cancer to forty gray in fifteen fractions over three weeks, 27 in five over one week, or 26 in five over one week to the whole breast or chest wall. Its five-year report found 26 in five non-inferior for ipsilateral breast-tumour relapse under the prespecified margin; the five-year relapse estimate after forty gray was 2.1%. Normal-tissue assessments differed by regimen: 27 produced more effects, whereas 26 did not show that increase versus forty. These are local-control and normal-tissue results in the tested setting, not a demonstration that a five-visit course is SBRT or an immune optimum.
